title: I got the beyond expectations bundle...

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
I have bought the beyond expectations bundle on humble bundle. It's the one affiliated with the jam.
I saw it was for charity, so I bought it. Now I can try things out like Sakan, Mado and Gene. Whatever those may be. I remember those coming out when MV was brand new, but I never really got into it.
I now also own Pixel Game Maker, which I will probably not use too much. Maybe I will play around with it some time. And I now own unite, which I will for sure never use.
However... Now I also have a spare key for both MV and VX Ace. I am not sure what to do with those. Does anyone have a fun idea how I can pass those on? (On no, "Give it to me" is not really a fun idea...)

posts.author: transcendnature
posts.body: I once gave a spare MV key I had to my usual fiverr artist way back when.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Wait until the next time you see someone here from a poor country to whom 10$ MV sale is a lot of money (or a kid who doesn't get allowance) and gift it to them.

make a lottery out of it or a friend in RL that want to try.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
GGG is "replacing" Pixel Game Maker MV with Action Game Maker built on Godot that's slated for a June release. Probably won't be as bad as Unite release but who knows.
When they try to piggyback on a bigger more established engine it just makes me want to use that engine instead.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Yeah, I don't see the point of an in-engine engine. I don't know how to work with unity and I understand it is very expensive, so I won't use it. If I knew how to use unity, I would probably use it without unite as well.
I'll keep those unite keys for now, though... Maybe my nephew would like them. Maybe I'll redeem them myself.
